title: Built to Remember, Shipped to Forget: Operational Contracts, Failures, and Repairs in Containerized LLM Agent Deployments
title_zh: 为记住而构建，为遗忘而部署：容器化LLM智能体部署中的运行契约、故障与修复

paragraphs.en: LLM agent systems reach production as container images run by platforms such as Docker, Compose, and Kubernetes. Framework and platform document opposite expectations: to the platform a container is disposable, while the framework persists conversations, pauses runs for human input, and resumes interrupted work from saved state; each side specifies only its own behavior, so the obligations their composition creates are stated nowhere. We present the first empirical study of this boundary, stating these obligations as operational contracts : guarantees a deployment must provide to preserve an agent system’s required behavior when a deployment-platform event occurs. From the first-party documentation of LangGraph and the three platforms we derive 14 contracts and evaluate them with three independent sources of evidence: 433 deployed open-source agent systems, seven events induced on 12 of them, and 122 developer repairs mined from 39,261 commits, pull requests, and issues. At least one contract applies to 75.5% of the systems, yet its guarantee is routinely missing: of systems that must keep state beyond the process, 37.4% lose it to a restart and 41.5% to a container replacement, and every assessable deployment stops the framework’s production server mid-drain. Induced events turn 14 of 16 predicted violations into runtime failures and all seven predicted holds pass. The failures are born in deployment but repaired in code: developer repairs independently cover twelve of the fourteen contracts, 78% change application code, and only two in three fully restore the violated guarantee. The 14-contract catalogue, detection rules, fault-injection harness, and 35-pattern repair taxonomy provide a basis for checking and strengthening agent deployments.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 智能体系统以容器镜像的形式投入生产，由 Docker、Compose 和 Kubernetes 等平台运行。 框架与平台对彼此的预期截然相反：对平台而言容器是一次性的，而框架却要持久化对话、暂停运行以等待人类输入，并从保存的状态中恢复被中断的工作；双方都只规定了自己的行为，因此二者组合所产生的义务无处被陈述。 我们首次对这一边界进行实证研究，将这些义务表述为操作性契约：即当一个部署平台事件发生时，部署必须提供的保证，以维持智能体系统所需的行为。 基于 LangGraph 与三个平台的第一方文档，我们推导出 14 条契约，并从三个独立的证据来源对其进行评估：433 个已部署的开源智能体系统、在其中 12 个系统上诱发的七种事件，以及从 39,261 次提交、拉取请求和议题中挖掘出的 122 个开发者修复。 至少有一条契约适用于 75.5% 的系统，但其保证却经常缺失：在必须将状态保留到进程之外（beyond the process）的系统中，37.4% 的系统会因重启而丢失状态，41.5% 会因容器替换而丢失状态，且每一个可评估的部署都会在清空（drain）过程中途停止框架的生产服务器。 诱发的事件将 16 个预测违规中的 14 个转化为运行时故障，而预测能够保持（hold）的七个全部通过。 这些故障在部署中产生，却在代码中被修复：开发者修复独立覆盖了 14 条契约中的 12 条，78% 的修复更改了应用代码，且只有三分之二的修复完整恢复了被违反的保证。 这份 14 条契约的目录、检测规则、故障注入工具，以及包含 35 种模式的修复分类法，为检查和强化智能体部署提供了基础。

paragraphs.en: Industry surveys report that a majority of organizations are adopting LLM agents, with over a third already running them in production [ 1 , 2 ] . An agent system is an application in which an LLM plans, calls tools, and acts over multiple steps on a user’s behalf, and it reaches its users the way any service does: packaged as a container image and operated by a platform such as Docker, Compose, or Kubernetes [ 3 , 4 ] . Agent frameworks endorse this path and instruct developers to package agents as Docker images [ 5 ] . Yet empirical studies of agent development consistently rank deployment among its hardest steps [ 6 , 7 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 行业调研报告显示，大多数组织正在采用大语言模型（LLM）智能体，其中超过三分之一已在生产环境中运行智能体 [ 1 , 2 ] 。 智能体系统是一种应用程序，其中大语言模型代表用户进行规划、调用工具并跨多个步骤执行操作，它以与服务相同的方式触达用户：打包为容器镜像，并由 Docker、Compose 或 Kubernetes 等平台进行运营 [ 3 , 4 ] 。 智能体框架认可这一路径，并指导开发者将智能体打包为 Docker 镜像 [ 5 ] 。 然而对智能体开发的实证研究一致将部署列为其中最困难的步骤之一 [ 6 , 7 ] 。

sents.zh: 然而对智能体开发的实证研究一致将部署列为其中最困难的步骤之一 [ 6 , 7 ] 。

paragraphs.en: One reason is that the platform and the framework document opposite expectations about the running container. To the platform, the container is disposable, designed to be stopped and replaced during normal operation, with nothing of lasting value inside: a stop sends SIGTERM and kills the process after a grace period of ten seconds by default [ 8 ] , an update replaces the container and discards its writable filesystem [ 9 , 10 ] , and anything that must survive these events is expected to live in volumes outside it [ 11 , 12 ] . To the framework, execution is anything but disposable: agents carry conversations across requests through a checkpointer [ 13 ] , pauses a run indefinitely until a person approves the next action [ 14 ] , and resumes interrupted work from saved state, and warns that resumption may re-execute steps completed before the interruption [ 15 ] , potentially repeating external actions such as sending an email, charging a payment, or provisioning a cloud resource. Each side specifies only its own layer, so whether a deployed agent satisfies both at once is settled by its artifacts.
paragraphs.zh: 原因之一在于，平台与框架对运行中的容器抱有截然相反的预期。 对平台而言，容器是一次性的，其设计目标就是在正常运行期间被停止并替换，内部没有任何具有持久价值的东西：停止操作会发送 SIGTERM 并在默认十秒的宽限期后终止进程 [ 8 ]，更新操作会替换容器并丢弃其可写文件系统 [ 9 , 10 ]，而任何必须在这些事件中留存下来的内容都应保存在容器之外的卷中 [ 11 , 12 ]。 对框架而言，执行绝非一次性：智能体通过检查点器 [ 13 ] 跨请求携带会话，无限期暂停一次运行直到有人批准下一步动作 [ 14 ]，并从保存的状态恢复被中断的工作，同时警告恢复可能会重新执行中断前已完成的步骤 [ 15 ]，从而可能重复诸如发送电子邮件、扣款或开通云资源等外部动作。 双方各自只规定了自己的那一层，因此一个已部署的智能体能否同时满足双方的要求，就由其制品决定了。

paragraphs.en: Research has approached this junction from two directions. Empirical studies of deployment artifacts quantify defects, smells, and misconfigurations in Dockerfiles, Compose files, and infrastructure-as-code, and build detectors for them [ 16 , 17 , 18 , 19 , 20 , 21 ] ; the rules they check encode platform best practices that apply to any containerized service, independent of the application inside. Empirical studies of LLM and agent applications characterize bugs, failures, and development challenges within the application [ 6 , 7 , 22 , 23 , 24 ] . However, no work identifies the obligations that arise only when one layer’s requirements are composed with the other’s lifecycle semantics. Consequently, we do not know what containerized deployments must guarantee for agent systems, how often real deployments provide these guarantees, whether violations become observable failures at runtime, or how developers repair them.
paragraphs.zh: 研究界从两个方向接近这一交汇点。 针对部署产物的实证研究量化了 Dockerfile、Compose 文件以及基础设施即代码中的缺陷、坏味道和错误配置，并为它们构建检测器 [ 16 , 17 , 18 , 19 , 20 , 21 ] ；这些研究所检查的规则编码了适用于任何容器化服务的平台最佳实践，与容器内的具体应用无关。 针对 LLM 和智能体应用的实证研究刻画了应用内部的缺陷、故障和开发挑战 [ 6 , 7 , 22 , 23 , 24 ] 。 然而，没有任何工作识别出只有当一层的寻址与另一层的生命周期语义相结合时才会产生的义务。 因此，我们不知道容器化部署必须为智能体系统保证什么，不知道真实部署在多大程度上提供了这些保证，不知道违反这些保证是否会在运行时表现为可观察的故障，也不知道开发者如何修复它们。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we present, to the best of our knowledge, the first empirical study of the operational boundary between an agent framework and container platforms. We introduce the operational contract (OC) : a guarantee that a containerized deployment must provide to preserve an agent system’s required behavior when a deployment-platform event occurs. We select LangGraph for two reasons: it belongs to the most widely adopted open-source toolchain for LLM application development [ 25 , 26 ] , an ecosystem in which 57% of surveyed teams report running agents in production [ 27 ] and it explicitly supports containerized deployment [ 5 ] . Our study follows the boundary from specification to practice. We first derive operational contracts from the first-party documentation of the framework and deployment platforms, then examine them through three independent sources of evidence: deployment artifacts from 433 open-source agent systems, controlled executions that induce seven deployment-platform events on 12 systems, and developer repairs mined from repository histories. We make four contributions:

paragraphs.en: We construct a corpus of LangGraph Agent systems that ship container deployments. Searching GitHub for repositories whose README mentions langgraph yields 225,367 candidates. To focus on established projects and exclude trivial or personal repositories, we retain those with at least 10 stars, a threshold used in prior work [ 29 ] , leaving approximately 4,345 repositories. From these candidates, we retain non-fork Python repositories that (i) use LangGraph in their own code, evidenced by a manifest dependency, a LangGraph import, or a langgraph.json and (ii) ship a Dockerfile. These criteria yield 574 repositories, which we pin to commits no later than our 6 July 2026 snapshot cutoff. We then manually verify that each shipped deployment runs a single agent graph defined in the repository itself; the following section describes this validation and the resulting analysis set.
paragraphs.zh: 我们构建了一个包含交付容器化部署的 LangGraph 智能体系统的语料库。 在 GitHub 上搜索 README 中提及 langgraph 的仓库，得到 225,367 个候选。 为了聚焦于成熟项目并排除琐碎或个人仓库，我们保留了至少拥有 10 个 star 的仓库（这一阈值在先前工作 [ 29 ] 中已被采用），最终留下约 4,345 个仓库。 从这些候选中，我们保留非 fork 的 Python 仓库，这些仓库需要满足：（i）在其自身代码中使用 LangGraph， evidenced 依据是 manifest 依赖声明、LangGraph 导入语句或 langgraph.json 文件；（ii）附带 Dockerfile。 这些筛选条件最终得到 574 个仓库，我们将其固定在 2026 年 7 月 6 日快照截止日期之前的 commit 上。 随后，我们人工验证每个交付的部署是否运行由仓库自身定义的单个智能体图；下一节将描述这一验证过程及由此得到的分析数据集。

paragraphs.en: For each system, we collect two forms of evidence. Facts are extracted mechanically from source and deployment files and retain their file-and-line provenance; examples include whether the system streams output, its restart policy, and its stop grace period. Labels capture properties that require interpretation of the code. Authors assign them at the pinned commit using a codebook that defines each field and its values, records supporting file-and-line evidence, and distinguishes absent , not applicable , and uncertain . Some labels apply to the entire corpus; others are needed only for systems to which a particular contract applies. We call the latter targeted readings . The codebook, and collected evidence are included in [ 28 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个系统，我们收集两类证据。 事实是从源代码和部署文件中以机械方式提取的，并保留其文件与行号出处；例如系统是否对流式输出、其重启策略以及其停止宽限期。 标签用于记录需要对代码进行解读才能得到的属性。 作者在固定的提交（commit）上依据一本代码手册为其赋值，该手册定义了每个字段及其取值，记录支持性的文件与行号证据，并区分「缺失」「不适用」和「不确定」三种情况。 部分标签适用于整个语料库；另一些标签仅在特定契约适用的系统上才需要。 我们将后者称为定向阅读。 该代码手册以及所收集的证据包含在 [ 28 ] 中。

paragraphs.en: Labeling procedure. We establish reliability in two stages. First, we draw a star-stratified pilot of 148 repositories and have two authors independently assign each applicable label. They adjudicate disagreements against the code and record the rationale; disagreements that expose an ambiguous rule lead to a codebook revision and re-coding of affected systems. Once the codebook is stable, we freeze it and divide the remaining 426 repositories between the two authors. For corpus-wide labels, both authors independently code a random 10% of this remaining set to verify that agreement persists. Targeted readings involve smaller subsets; after establishing pilot agreement, the first author codes the remaining systems. We report agreement with the RQ that first uses each label; unless stated otherwise, reported κ \kappa values refer to the pilot.
paragraphs.zh: 标注流程。 我们分两个阶段建立可靠性。 首先，我们按星标分层抽取 148 个仓库作为试点，由两位作者独立为每个适用的标签进行赋值。 他们对照编码手册裁定分歧并记录理由；若分歧暴露出模糊的规则，则修订编码手册并重新编码受影响的系统。 编码手册稳定后，我们将其冻结，并把剩余的 426 个仓库分给两位作者。 对于语料库层面的标签，两位作者对剩余集合中随机抽取的 10% 进行独立编码，以验证一致性得以保持。 针对性阅读涉及的子集较小；在试点阶段建立一致性后，第一作者对剩余系统进行编码。 我们在与每个标签首次相关的 RQ 处报告一致性；除非另有说明，所报告的 κ \kappa 值均指试点阶段。

paragraphs.en: Manual screening: scope and unit of analysis. The first label, scope , completes corpus selection. While the automated filters of Section II-A establish that a repository uses LangGraph and ships a container deployment, scope determines whether that deployment actually executes a LangGraph graph defined in the repository. We trace the container entrypoint, Compose services, and langgraph.json target to the code they execute, excluding repositories in which no container executes the graph, the graph is not invoked on the deployed path, or the deployment runs only a model server or a graph defined elsewhere. A second label establishes the unit of analysis. For each in-scope repository, we identify its primary deployed graph from the langgraph.json target or, when absent, the graph invoked by the container entrypoint. Repositories that deploy several unrelated graphs are labeled collections and excluded, avoiding both the aggregation of unrelated systems into one verdict and multiple systems from the same repository. Following the labeling procedure above, the authors agree in the pilot on scope for 137 of 148 repositories ( κ = .62 \kappa=.62 , A ​ C 1 = .91 AC_{1}=.91 ) and on collection status for 140 ( κ = .61 \kappa=.61 , A ​ C 1 = .94 AC_{1}=.94 ). Of the 574 repositories, 82 are out of scope and 59 are collections, leaving 433 deployed agent systems for analysis.

paragraphs.en: Motivation. Container platforms routinely restart, replace, and terminate containers, while agent frameworks require state and running work to survive these deployment-platform events [ 11 , 30 , 9 , 12 , 13 , 14 , 15 ] . Preserving state alone does not satisfy these requirements: an interrupted run may remain unfinished even when its state survives, and resuming it may re-execute side effects [ 15 ] . The framework and deployment platform each document their own behavior, but neither states the obligation a deployment must satisfy when the two are combined. RQ1 makes these obligations explicit as operational contracts.
paragraphs.zh: 动机。 容器平台会例行地重启、替换和终止容器，而智能体框架要求状态和正在运行的工作能够在这些部署平台事件中存活下来 [ 11 , 30 , 9 , 12 , 13 , 14 , 15 ] 。 仅保存状态并不能满足这些要求：即使状态得以保留，一次被中断的运行仍可能未完成，而恢复运行可能会重复执行副作用 [ 15 ] 。 框架和部署平台各自记录了自身的行为，但二者都没有说明将两者结合使用时部署必须满足的义务。 RQ1 将这些义务明确为操作性契约。

paragraphs.en: Approach. We derive operational contracts by reading the agent-framework and deployment-platform documentation together. Each contract connects three elements: an agent-framework requirement , a deployment-platform event that can violate it, and the deployment obligation that prevents the violation. A contract applies only to systems for which its agent-framework requirement is relevant. We derive the contracts in four steps: source selection, candidate extraction, human validation and consolidation, and classification.

paragraphs.en: (i) Source selection. Following prior work on deriving developer directives from official documentation [ 31 ] , we use only first-party sources. For the agent framework, we include the LangGraph libraries and production server; for the deployment platform, we include Docker, Docker Compose, and Kubernetes, covering container execution, composition, and orchestration [ 9 , 10 , 12 , 32 , 33 , 34 ] . For reproducibility, we freeze each documentation set at the versions used in the study; exact versions and snapshots are in the replication package.

paragraphs.en: (ii) Candidate extraction. A candidate contract connects a documented agent-framework requirement with a documented deployment-platform event that can violate it. We use Claude Opus 5.5 as an extraction instrument. The model extracts both statements verbatim with their sources, pairs them across the two documentation sets, and turns each conflicting pair into a candidate contract by stating the corresponding deployment obligation . Figure 2 illustrates the process. LangGraph’s production server allows up to 180 seconds to drain running work after a shutdown signal [ 35 ] , whereas Docker sends SIGTERM on stop and SIGKILL after a default 10-second grace period [ 8 ] . Together, these statements yield the candidate contract the stop grace period covers the drain , so that a stop does not violate the drain of running work . A script verifies every extracted quotation against the pinned documentation, and two authors validate every candidate in step (iii). paragraphs.en: (iii) Validation and consolidation. Two authors independently validate the 45 candidates against their supporting agent-framework and deployment-platform quotations. A candidate is retained only when the documentation establishes an agent-framework requirement and a deployment-platform event that can violate it, and the conflict can arise under normal deployment-platform operation without requiring an exceptional event or a specialized configuration. The authors agree on 41 of 45 decisions ( κ = .72 \kappa=.72 , A ​ C 1 = .87 AC_{1}=.87 ); disagreements are resolved against the quoted evidence. This validation excludes 11 candidates and retains 34. The authors then independently consolidate candidates that express the same deployment obligation under the same deployment-platform event. For example, three candidates require state to survive a container restart but concern different forms of state: conversation checkpoints in an in-memory checkpointer, long-term memories in an in-memory store, and LangGraph’s state directory. Because the deployment obligation and deployment-platform event are the same, we consolidate them into one operational contract and retain the three forms of state as instances; the contract applies only to systems that maintain the corresponding state. The authors agree on 94.7% of pairwise consolidation decisions ( κ = .71 \kappa=.71 ); after adjudication, consolidation yields 14 operational contracts.

paragraphs.en: (iv) Classification. Finally, we classify each operational contract by severity and static checkability . Severity captures the recoverability of the documented consequence [ 40 , 41 ] : high if retry, restart, or manual intervention cannot restore the intended outcome, as when saved state is lost or an external action is repeated; medium if execution is disrupted but recovery remains possible, as when running work is lost or stalled, a service remains unavailable, or resources remain running until corrective action; and low if the effect is recoverable and confined to a single request or stream. Static checkability captures whether a contract can be evaluated from repository artifacts alone. A contract is statically checkable when both its applicability and the evidence needed to determine whether its deployment obligation is satisfied are observable in source and deployment files; otherwise, runtime evidence is required. The authors fixed these criteria before classification and independently classified all 14 contracts, agreeing on all 14 severity classifications and 13 of 14 static-checkability classifications. The disagreement was resolved by discussion.
paragraphs.zh: (iv) 分类。 最后，我们按严重程度和静态可检查性对每份操作性契约进行分类。 严重程度刻画的是所记录后果的可恢复性 [40, 41]：若重试、重启或人工干预都无法恢复预期结果，则为高，例如保存的状态丢失或某个外部操作被重复执行；若执行被中断但恢复仍然可能，则为中，例如运行中的工作丢失或停滞、某个服务持续不可用，或资源在采取纠正措施之前持续运行；若影响可恢复且仅局限于单个请求或流，则为低。 静态可检查性刻画的是一份契约能否仅凭仓库中的制品进行评估。 当契约的适用性以及判断其部署义务是否被满足所需的证据都能在源代码和部署文件中观察到时，该契约就是静态可检查的；否则就需要运行时证据。 作者在分类之前先确定了这些标准，并独立对全部 14 份契约进行了分类，在全部 14 项严重程度分类以及 14 项静态可检查性分类中的 13 项上达成一致。 这一分歧通过讨论得到了解决。

paragraphs.en: Deploying agents on container platforms gives rise to fourteen operational contracts, each guarding against a distinct failure risk. Saved state can be lost when a process restarts (OC1), when its container is replaced (OC2), or become inconsistent when requests reach replicas that do not share state (OC3). Running work introduces different conflicts: a stop can terminate a run before its drain completes (OC4), while resumption after a mid-step interruption can repeat an external action (OC7). The consequences extend beyond the run: external resources can remain running after a kill (OC9), and container replacement can interrupt a client’s stream (OC11). In each case, the framework and platform behave as documented; the violation arises from their composition.
paragraphs.zh: 将智能体部署到容器平台上会产生十四项运维契约，每一项都用于防范一种不同的故障风险。 已保存的状态可能在进程重启时丢失（OC1），在容器被替换时丢失（OC2），或者当请求到达不共享状态的副本时变得不一致（OC3）。 运行中的工作会带来不同的冲突：停止操作可能在一次运行的排空完成之前将其终止（OC4），而步骤中途被中断后的恢复可能重复执行某个外部动作（OC7）。 其影响超出了运行本身：被强制终止后外部资源可能仍在运行（OC9），容器替换可能中断客户端的流（OC11）。 在每一种情况下，框架与平台的行为都符合其文档所述；违规源于二者的组合。

paragraphs.en: Persisting agent state satisfies only four of the fourteen deployment obligations. The other ten extend beyond saved state: running work must drain or resume after interruption, re-executed side effects must be harmless, workers must remain available, interrupted streams must resume, and external resources must be released.
paragraphs.zh: 持久化智能体状态仅满足十四项部署义务中的四项。 其余十项超出了已保存状态的范畴：中断后运行中的工作必须排空或恢复，重新执行副作用必须无害，工作进程必须保持可用，被中断的流必须恢复，外部资源必须释放。

paragraphs.en: Approach. RQ2 uses the two forms of evidence defined in Section II-B : facts , extracted from source and deployment files, and labels , assigned by the authors under the procedure of Section II-B . We use facts when repository evidence is explicit and labels when interpretation is required. Each labeled field is defined at its first use, with its agreement. For each system, we determine whether a contract applies and, when it does, whether it holds . A contract applies when its agent-framework requirement is relevant to the system and holds when the deployment satisfies its obligation. We encode these decisions in one detection rule per contract, derived from Table I and its supporting quotations. One author derives each rule, a second independently reviews it against the contract, and a third adjudicates disagreements. The complete rules are in [ 28 ] .

paragraphs.en: (ii) Contract satisfaction evidence. For some contracts, facts directly establish whether the deployment obligation is satisfied: the restart policy (OC12), stop grace period (OC4), update strategy (OC13), volume for database data (OC2), run durability setting (OC6), and wait for database health (OC10). The remaining require labels . For the saved-state contracts (OC1–OC3), we first label the checkpointer used by the deployed system ( κ = .73 \kappa=.73 ), then inspect cases where persistence depends on application or deployment behavior: where 83 systems without a checkpointer keep their state ( κ = .78 \kappa=.78 ); which checkpointer the deployment selects when several can be constructed (63 systems; κ = .72 \kappa=.72 ); whether checkpoint files lie within a declared mount (63; κ = .73 \kappa=.73 ); and whether paused runs survive restart (77 systems; κ = .94 \kappa=.94 ). For 135 systems that start several containers from one image, we additionally determine whether they are replicas or distinct roles ( κ = .83 \kappa=.83 ) and whether every instance reaches the same state ( κ = .72 \kappa=.72 ). For OC8 and OC9, we inspect whether the repository provides a mechanism to resume interrupted runs and to release external resources after a kill (93 systems; κ = .85 \kappa=.85 – 1.00 1.00 on the 28 double-coded systems). For (OC2–OC6), we additionally search the pinned source for the implementations relevant to each obligation, including persistent volumes for Kubernetes-hosted state, worker processes, shutdown handlers, and progress saved during a run, and inspect every match ( κ = .78 \kappa=.78 ).

paragraphs.en: At least one operational contract applies to 75.5% of agent systems: 61.2% need durable state, 19.9% run work in the background, and 60.3% stream output to clients. paragraphs.en: 37% of agent systems that need durable state lose it on an ordinary restart. Of the 265 systems to which OC1 applies, 166 (62.6%) hold the contract, whereas 99 (37.4% [31.8–43.3]) lose a conversation, paused run, or memory that must outlive the process. The rate is similar among multi-turn conversational systems (87/221, 39.4%). Most systems that break OC1 (77/99, 77.8%) ship no persistent store; the remaining 22 ship one that the agent state does not reach. Indeed, 16 of 76 systems using an in-memory checkpointer deploy a persistent store alongside it without routing agent state there.
paragraphs.zh: 在需要持久化状态的智能体系统中，37% 会在一次普通重启后丢失状态。 在 OC1 适用的 265 个系统中，166 个（62.6%）符合该约定，而 99 个（37.4% [31.8–43.3]）会丢失必须比进程存活更久的会话、暂停的运行或记忆。 在多轮对话系统中，该比率相近（87/221，39.4%）。 大多数违反 OC1 的系统（77/99，77.8%）没有部署任何持久化存储；其余 22 个系统虽然部署了持久化存储，但智能体状态并未写入其中。 事实上，在使用内存检查点器的 76 个系统中，有 16 个在部署内存检查点器的同时也部署了持久化存储，却没有把智能体状态路由到那里。

paragraphs.en: Preserving agent state through one deployment-platform event does not ensure it survives the next. Figure 3 follows the 265 systems that need durable state through cumulative contract checks. Of these, 166 (62.6%) preserve state across restart (OC1), and 155 (58.5%) also preserve it across container replacement (OC2); thus, eleven survive restart but lose state on redeployment. Only 134 (50.6%) have no further broken contract that repository evidence can establish. This is an upper bound: 85 of the 134 have at least one applicable contract that is not decidable from repository evidence, including 82 that require runtime evidence.

paragraphs.en: Every production-server deployment provides less time than required to drain running work. OC4 applies to 27 systems: 12 use LangGraph’s production server, with its 180-second drain window, and 15 implement their own drain. Because the latter depends on the running work being drained, OC4 is decidable from repository evidence only for eight production-server deployments. All eight retain Docker’s default 10-second stop grace period, 170 seconds shorter than the configured drain window. Three systems with their own drain fail earlier: SIGTERM does not reach the application, so the drain never starts (OC5). paragraphs.en: Motivation. RQ2 derives verdicts from repository evidence, but cannot show what happens when a deployment-platform event occurs; some contracts also require runtime evidence. RQ3 therefore executes the deployments, induces the deployment-platform events, and observes whether contracts predicted to hold or be broken behave accordingly at runtime.
paragraphs.zh: 动机。 RQ2 从仓库证据得出结论，但无法展示部署平台事件发生时会出现什么情况；部分合约还需要运行时证据。 RQ3 因此实际执行部署，诱发部署平台事件，并观察被预测为成立或被打破的合约在运行时是否表现一致。

sents.en: Motivation.
sents.zh: 动机。

sents.en: RQ2 derives verdicts from repository evidence, but cannot show what happens when a deployment-platform event occurs; some contracts also require runtime evidence.
sents.zh: RQ2 从仓库证据得出结论，但无法展示部署平台事件发生时会出现什么情况；部分合约还需要运行时证据。

sents.en: RQ3 therefore executes the deployments, induces the deployment-platform events, and observes whether contracts predicted to hold or be broken behave accordingly at runtime.
sents.zh: RQ3 因此实际执行部署，诱发部署平台事件，并观察被预测为成立或被打破的合约在运行时是否表现一致。

paragraphs.en: Approach. We evaluate the RQ2 verdicts in four steps: (i) select contracts whose deployment-platform events can be reproduced and observed, (ii) select systems predicted to hold or break each contract, (iii) deploy each system as shipped and induce the corresponding deployment-platform event, and (iv) compare the outcome with the prediction.
paragraphs.zh: 方法。 我们分四步评估 RQ2 的判定：(i) 选择其部署平台事件可以被复现和观察的合约，(ii) 选择被预测为满足或破坏每个合约的系统，(iii) 按原始发布状态部署每个系统并诱发相应的部署平台事件，以及 (iv) 将结果与预测进行比较。

sents.en: Approach.
sents.zh: 方法。

sents.en: We evaluate the RQ2 verdicts in four steps: (i) select contracts whose deployment-platform events can be reproduced and observed, (ii) select systems predicted to hold or break each contract, (iii) deploy each system as shipped and induce the corresponding deployment-platform event, and (iv) compare the outcome with the prediction.
sents.zh: 我们分四步评估 RQ2 的判定：(i) 选择其部署平台事件可以被复现和观察的合约，(ii) 选择被预测为满足或破坏每个合约的系统，(iii) 按原始发布状态部署每个系统并诱发相应的部署平台事件，以及 (iv) 将结果与预测进行比较。

paragraphs.en: (i) Contract and event selection. We select contracts whose deployment-platform event can be induced by a documented Docker or Compose operation and whose outcome can be observed without modifying the system’s code or deployment configuration, apart from the model-routing changes of step (iii). The resulting events (Table III ) are restart, container replacement, kill, stop under Docker’s default 10-second grace period, forced recreation, server-process crash, and cold start. 1 1 1 We reproduce a crash by sending SIGKILL directly to the server process, analogous to an out-of-memory kill. We avoid docker kill because Docker treats it as a user stop and bypasses the restart policy. The expected runtime outcome follows from the documented deployment-platform semantics. For example, restart clears process memory but preserves the container filesystem; replacement discards that filesystem; and named volumes survive both. Before executing any agent system, we verify each event effect on a minimal Compose deployment. Eleven of the fourteen contracts meet these criteria. We exclude OC3 because testing it requires adding replicas, OC14 because inducing an OOM kill requires changing the memory limit or constructing a workload that exhausts it, and OC9 because its external resources require paid provider accounts. OC7 and OC11 require runtime evidence, so we execute them without an RQ2 prediction and report the observed outcome. OC8 has no RQ2 verdict: repository files can reveal a resumption mechanism, but not whether interrupted runs actually resume. We instead predict its outcome from the OC8 reading (Section IV ): a system with no mechanism should leave the run unfinished, and one that resumes runs at start-up or takes them from a redelivering queue should complete it.
paragraphs.zh: (i) 合约与事件选择。 我们选择的合约需满足：其部署平台事件可由有文档记载的 Docker 或 Compose 操作诱发，且除步骤 (iii) 的模型路由更改外，无需修改系统代码或部署配置即可观察到其结果。 由此得到的事件（表 III）包括：重启、容器替换、终止（kill）、在 Docker 默认 10 秒宽限期内的停止（stop）、强制重建、服务器进程崩溃以及冷启动。1 1 1 我们通过直接向服务器进程发送 SIGKILL 来复现崩溃，类似于内存不足（out-of-memory）导致的终止。 我们避免使用 docker kill，因为 Docker 将其视为用户主动停止，并绕过重启策略。 预期的运行时结果可由有文档记载的部署平台语义推导得出。 例如，重启会清除进程内存但保留容器文件系统；替换会丢弃该文件系统；而命名卷在两者之后都会保留。 在执行任何智能体系统之前，我们在一个最小的 Compose 部署上验证每个事件的效果。 十四个合约中有十一个满足这些标准。 我们排除 OC3，因为测试它需要添加副本；排除 OC14，因为诱发 OOM 终止需要更改内存限制或构造耗尽内存的工作负载；排除 OC9，因为其外部资源需要付费的提供商账户。 OC7 和 OC11 需要运行时证据，因此我们在没有 RQ2 预测的情况下执行它们，并报告观察到的结果。 OC8 没有 RQ2 判定：仓库文件可以揭示是否存在恢复机制，但无法表明被中断的运行是否真的会恢复。 我们转而根据 OC8 的阅读结果（第 IV 节）预测其结果：没有恢复机制的智能体系统应使运行保持未完成状态，而在启动时恢复运行或从重新投递队列中获取运行的智能体系统则应使运行完成。

paragraphs.en: Stage 1: static eligibility (433 → \rightarrow 180). Using the facts of Section II-B , we retain systems that can be exercised without modifying their code or deployment files. paragraphs.en: (iv) Checks and predictions. For each RQ2 verdict, and for OC8 from its reading, we fix the expected runtime outcome before execution: a contract that is broken should fail its check, whereas one that holds should pass. An observation confirms or contradicts this prediction, or is inconclusive (Table III ). OC7 and OC11 have no prediction and are measured directly. Each contract is exercised under a workload that makes its obligation observable. Saved-state contracts use a conversation, running-work contracts use a run in progress, and OC5, OC10, and OC12 require no workload because they test an idle stop, cold start, and server crash, respectively. For saved state, we use LongMemEval [ 42 ] to determine whether a conversation survives without judging the model’s answer. We replay its three shortest single-session histories as separate threads; each provides a later question and identifies the earlier turns needed to answer it. We ask the question and inspect the proxy log for those turns: their presence means the conversation is preserved; their absence, or a thread-not-found response, means it is lost; a connection failure is inconclusive. We perform this check after replay, after waiting for the duration of the deployment-platform event without inducing it, and after the event. We score post-event loss only when pre-event checks confirm that the conversation was preserved. For running work, we start a run through the system’s API using a repository-provided request from its README, tests, or example code; the exact requests are in [ 28 ] . The proxy keeps the run in progress while the deployment-platform event is induced. Table III gives the contract-specific checks: running work drains before termination (OC4), progress is saved during the run (OC6), and an interrupted run resumes without resubmission within 300 s (OC8). OC5 checks whether SIGTERM reaches the application, OC10 whether the system becomes ready within 120 s of a cold start, and OC12 whether the server restarts within 60 s of a crash. OC7 and OC11 measure whether re-execution repeats an external action and whether an interrupted stream can resume, respectively. We repeat each deployment-platform event three times. A repetition counts only when its required pre-event condition holds: the conversation is available, the run is in progress, or the server is running, as appropriate.

paragraphs.en: Execution shows that satisfying one contract does not ensure the next: agent state can survive a restart but not a replacement, an interrupted run can retain its state but never resume, and shutdown can begin but not finish before termination. tool-kit-ai and SRE-Agent keep all tested conversations across restart (OC1) but lose them after container replacement (OC2), because their state remains inside the container. langmanus keeps conversation state in process memory and loses it on restart (OC1). The distinction extends to running work: IdeaGo preserves completed progress after interruption (OC6), yet the interrupted run remains “in progress” and is not resumed (OC8). The deep-research agent likewise cannot resume a paused run after restart or complete a run interrupted by a kill. In contrast, MemCoach resumes its paused run from state on a bind mount, and LambChat resumes its interrupted run within 30 s. Shutdown exposes the same pattern. On both tested systems using LangGraph’s production server, SIGTERM initiates shutdown, but Docker’s 10-second stop grace period expires before running work drains (OC4). Forced recreation interrupts the running worker (OC13), while a server-process crash leaves the server down without a restart policy (OC12). For OC5, one system never receives SIGTERM; another receives it but exceeds the stop grace period, breaking OC4 rather than OC5.

sents.en: Execution shows that satisfying one contract does not ensure the next: agent state can survive a restart but not a replacement, an interrupted run can retain its state but never resume, and shutdown can begin but not finish before termination. tool-kit-ai and SRE-Agent keep all tested conversations across restart (OC1) but lose them after container replacement (OC2), because their state remains inside the container. langmanus keeps conversation state in process memory and loses it on restart (OC1).

sents.en: On both tested systems using LangGraph’s production server, SIGTERM initiates shutdown, but Docker’s 10-second stop grace period expires before running work drains (OC4).

paragraphs.en: Two violations predicted from repository evidence do not become agent failures at runtime because the deployed image provides safeguards that the repository does not expose. Panaversity accounts for both cases. Its Compose file neither waits for database readiness (OC10) nor mounts the state directory used by langgraph dev (OC2), yet the agent starts after every cold deployment and preserves every tested conversation across replacement. The pulled Agent Server image explains both outcomes: it retries the database and runs migrations before serving, and uses the Postgres-backed server with conversation state on a named volume. When the development server runs without this safeguard, as in SRE-Agent , the predicted OC2 failure manifests.
paragraphs.zh: 由仓库证据预测出的两处违规在运行时并未成为智能体故障，因为部署的镜像提供了仓库中未暴露的防护措施。 Panaversity 对这两种情况都有所考虑。 其 Compose 文件既不等待数据库就绪（OC10），也不挂载 langgraph dev 使用的状态目录（OC2），但智能体在每次冷部署后都能启动，并且在替换过程中保留了每一个经过测试的会话。 拉取的 Agent Server 镜像解释了这两种结果：它在提供服务前会重试数据库连接并运行迁移，并且使用带命名卷存储会话状态的 Postgres 后端服务器。 当开发服务器在没有此防护措施的情况下运行时（如 SRE-Agent），预测的 OC2 故障就会显现。

paragraphs.en: When an interrupted agent run is resumed, the interrupted step is re-executed and can therefore repeat its side effects. OC4 and OC13 interrupt running work on both tested systems, but the server subsequently resumes and completes each run 10–221 s later. Resumption re-executes the interrupted step: the proxy records its model call a second time. Thus, recovery can delay completion and can repeat an external action already performed by that step (OC7).
paragraphs.zh: 当被中断的智能体运行被恢复时，被中断的步骤会被重新执行，因此可能重复其副作用。 OC4 和 OC13 在两个被测系统上都会中断正在运行的工作，但服务器随后会恢复运行，并在 10–221 秒后完成每次运行。 恢复会重新执行被中断的步骤：代理会第二次记录其模型调用。 因此，恢复可能延迟完成，并可能重复该步骤已经执行过的外部操作（OC7）。

sents.en: When an interrupted agent run is resumed, the interrupted step is re-executed and can therefore repeat its side effects.
sents.zh: 当被中断的智能体运行被恢复时，被中断的步骤会被重新执行，因此可能重复其副作用。

sents.en: OC4 and OC13 interrupt running work on both tested systems, but the server subsequently resumes and completes each run 10–221 s later.

sents.en: Thus, recovery can delay completion and can repeat an external action already performed by that step (OC7).
sents.zh: 因此，恢复可能延迟完成，并可能重复该步骤已经执行过的外部操作（OC7）。

paragraphs.en: Without a mechanism to resume interrupted work, recovery repeats the entire agent run, while an interrupted stream remains incomplete. The deep-research agent exhibits both outcomes. After a kill, resubmitting its request starts a new run and repeats every model call made before the interruption, rather than only the interrupted step (OC7). During streaming, forced recreation terminates the connection; the API provides no mechanism to resume the stream or retrieve the remaining output, so the client misses the rest of the answer (OC11).
paragraphs.zh: 缺乏恢复中断工作的机制时，恢复过程会重复整个智能体的运行，而被中断的流则保持不完整。 深度研究智能体同时表现出这两种结果。 在进程被杀死后，重新提交其请求会开启一次新的运行，并重复中断前进行的每一次模型调用，而不仅仅是被中断的那一步（OC7）。 在流式传输过程中，强制重建会终止连接；API 不提供恢复流或获取剩余输出的机制，因此客户端会丢失答案的其余部分（OC11）。

sents.zh: 缺乏恢复中断工作的机制时，恢复过程会重复整个智能体的运行，而被中断的流则保持不完整。

paragraphs.en: Motivation. RQ2 identifies contract violations in deployed agent systems, and RQ3 shows that they manifest at runtime. RQ4 turns to repository histories for independent evidence of whether developers encounter these violations in practice and how they repair them. We examine which contracts appear in developer repairs, the recurring repair strategies, and whether each repair satisfies the full deployment obligation.
paragraphs.zh: 研究动机。 RQ2 识别已部署智能体系统中的契约违例，RQ3 表明这些违例会在运行时显现。 RQ4 转向代码仓库历史，以获取开发者在实践中是否遇到这些违例以及如何修复它们的独立证据。 我们考察哪些契约出现在开发者的修复中、反复出现的修复策略，以及每个修复是否满足完整的部署义务。

sents.en: Motivation.
sents.zh: 研究动机。

sents.en: RQ2 identifies contract violations in deployed agent systems, and RQ3 shows that they manifest at runtime.
sents.zh: RQ2 识别已部署智能体系统中的契约违例，RQ3 表明这些违例会在运行时显现。

sents.en: RQ4 turns to repository histories for independent evidence of whether developers encounter these violations in practice and how they repair them.

paragraphs.en: Approach. (i) Retrieval. Through the GitHub API, we search public commits, pull requests, and issues using queries that pair langgraph with keywords covering deployment-platform events (e.g., restart , kill ), agent-framework requirements (e.g., checkpoint , resume ), and deployment obligations (e.g., persist , retry ). After independently reading 200 retrieved artifacts, two authors add, by agreement, developer terms for the same phenomena (e.g., crash , stuck , orphan ). The queries, run on 2 September 2026, return 39,261 artifacts. We rank artifacts by the number of distinct keywords matched. From the highest score downward, one author inspects 100 artifacts per score and stops at the first score with no relevant failure report. The resulting cutoff retains 7,268 artifacts from 270 repositories. All queries are in the replication package.
paragraphs.zh: 方法。(i) 检索。 通过 GitHub API，我们使用将 langgraph 与以下关键词组合的查询来搜索公开的提交、拉取请求和议题：涵盖部署平台事件的关键词（如 restart、kill）、智能体框架需求的关键词（如 checkpoint、resume）以及部署义务的关键词（如 persist、retry）。 在独立阅读 200 个检索到的工件后，两位作者经协商一致，为相同现象补充了开发者术语（如 crash、stuck、orphan）。 这些查询于 2026 年 9 月 2 日运行，返回 39,261 个工件。 我们按匹配到的不同关键词数量对工件进行排序。 从最高分开始向下，一位作者对每个分数检查 100 个工件，并在第一个没有相关失败报告的分数处停止。 由此得到的截止点保留了来自 270 个代码仓库的 7,268 个工件。 所有查询均包含在复现包中。

paragraphs.en: (ii) Screening. Keyword retrieval favors recall, so artifacts may not describe relevant failures. Following two-phase sampling [ 43 ] , we use GPT-5.4 mini to screen them for a failure following a deployment-platform event or a change intended to fix or prevent one. The model serves only as a screening instrument; the authors validate every retained candidate from the original artifacts and diffs in step (iii). Screening yields 396 candidates from 98 repositories. To assess screening misses, two authors independently inspect a random sample of 100 rejected artifacts ( κ = 1 \kappa=1 ) and find one missed repair.

paragraphs.en: (iii) Validation. A repair is a commit, or the commits of a pull request, that fixes or explicitly prevents a failure caused by a deployment-platform event. We reconstruct failure–repair pairs through GitHub cross-references: from an issue to the change that closes or references it, and from a commit or pull request to the failure described in its message, linked issue, or diff. Issues without a fixing change, features, and refactorings are excluded. Two authors independently validate 130 of the 396 candidates (33%; κ = .85 \kappa=.85 ); disagreements are resolved by discussion, and the first author applies the resulting rules to the remainder. This yields 122 repairs from 63 repositories.
paragraphs.zh: (iii) 有效性验证。 修复是指一个提交（commit）或一个拉取请求（pull request）中的多个提交，它们修复或明确防止了由部署平台事件引起的故障。 我们通过 GitHub 交叉引用来重建故障–修复对：从 issue 追溯到关闭或引用它的变更，以及从提交或拉取请求追溯到其消息、关联 issue 或 diff 中描述的故障。 没有修复变更的 issue、功能开发以及重构均被排除。 两位作者独立验证了 396 个候选中的 130 个（33%；κ = .85 \kappa=.85）；分歧通过讨论解决，第一作者将由此得出的规则应用于其余候选。 最终得到来自 63 个代码仓库的 122 个修复。

paragraphs.en: (iv) Coding. We code each repair along three facets. Contract identifies the operational contract whose violation the repair addresses, or none when no contract applies ( κ = .91 \kappa=.91 ). Fix captures what the developer changes. Two authors independently describe each change in the double-coded sample ( κ = .92 \kappa=.92 ), then consolidate the descriptions into recurring fixes and families. The first author codes the remaining repairs, after which both authors review all assignments and refine the taxonomy where necessary. We also record whether each repair modifies application code, deployment files, or both. paragraphs.en: Construct validity. The contracts are bounded by the pinned documentation, and RQ2 by repository evidence; behavior hidden inside deployed images can therefore escape both, as the two RQ3 mismatches show. We mark a contract broken only on positive evidence and not decidable otherwise, making RQ2 violation rates lower bounds. RQ3 mitigates measurement error through pre-event checks, validated deployment-platform events, and three repetitions.
paragraphs.zh: 构念效度。 契约以固定版本文档为界，RQ2 以代码库证据为界；因此部署镜像内部隐藏的行为可能同时逃过两者，正如 RQ2 之后的两个 RQ3 不匹配所示。 我们仅在有正面证据时将契约标记为已破坏，否则判定为不可判定，这使 RQ2 的违规率成为下界。 RQ3 通过事件前检查、经验证的部署平台事件以及三次重复来减轻测量误差。

paragraphs.en: Several empirical studies examine how developers build and operate agent systems. Chen et al. [ 6 ] studied the challenges facing LLM application developers and reported deployment among the recurring ones; Asgari et al. [ 24 ] drew the challenges of agent systems from Stack Overflow posts and GitHub issues; Pan et al. [ 7 ] measured agents in production; further studies examined developer practices, industrial adoption, configuration, and observability [ 59 , 60 , 61 , 62 , 63 ] . A second line of work studies failures within agent systems. Cemri et al. [ 23 ] derived from multi-agent execution traces a taxonomy of failure modes in how agents specify, coordinate, and verify their work, and Islam et al. [ 22 ] studied bugs in LLM agents. Other studies examine error propagation and accountability in role-specialized multi-agent pipelines [ 64 , 65 ] . Comparable studies preceded them for deep-learning software [ 66 , 67 ] . Our study addresses a different failure boundary: the interaction between agent-framework requirements and deployment-platform behavior. Rather than deriving failures from execution traces or developer reports, we derive operational contracts from framework and deployment-platform documentation and examine whether ordinary deployment-platform events such as restart, replacement, and shutdown violate the requirements of otherwise correctly executing agents.
paragraphs.zh: 多项实证研究考察了开发者如何构建和运营智能体系统。Chen 等人 [ 6 ] 研究了 LLM 应用开发者面临的挑战，并指出部署是反复出现的挑战之一；Asgari 等人 [ 24 ] 从 Stack Overflow 帖子和 GitHub issue 中归纳了智能体系统面临的挑战；Pan 等人 [ 7 ] 对生产环境中的智能体进行了度量；进一步的研究考察了开发者的实践、产业界的采用情况、配置以及可观测性 [ 59 , 60 , 61 , 62 , 63 ] 。 第二类工作研究智能体系统内部的失效。Cemri 等人 [ 23 ] 从多智能体执行轨迹中归纳出了智能体在规定、协调和验证其工作时的失效模式分类法，Islam 等人 [ 22 ] 研究了 LLM 智能体中的缺陷。 另一些研究考察了角色专业化多智能体流水线中的错误传播与责任归属 [ 64 , 65 ] 。 类似的研究此前也针对深度学习软件开展过 [ 66 , 67 ] 。 我们的研究针对的是另一条失效边界：智能体框架需求与部署平台行为之间的交互。 我们不是从执行轨迹或开发者报告中归纳失效，而是从框架和部署平台的文档中归纳运行规约，并考察重启、替换和关机等普通部署平台事件是否会违反原本正确执行的智能体所提出的需求。

sents.en: Our study addresses a different failure boundary: the interaction between agent-framework requirements and deployment-platform behavior.
sents.zh: 我们的研究针对的是另一条失效边界：智能体框架需求与部署平台行为之间的交互。

sents.en: Rather than deriving failures from execution traces or developer reports, we derive operational contracts from framework and deployment-platform documentation and examine whether ordinary deployment-platform events such as restart, replacement, and shutdown violate the requirements of otherwise correctly executing agents.
sents.zh: 我们不是从执行轨迹或开发者报告中归纳失效，而是从框架和部署平台的文档中归纳运行规约，并考察重启、替换和关机等普通部署平台事件是否会违反原本正确执行的智能体所提出的需求。

paragraphs.en: Prior work has extensively studied container deployment artifacts. Studies have characterized Docker usage [ 16 ] , identified Docker-specific refactorings and technical debt [ 68 , 69 ] , and catalogued practices and misconfigurations in Dockerfiles [ 17 , 18 ] , Compose files [ 19 , 70 ] , and Kubernetes manifests [ 71 , 72 , 20 , 21 ] . Most closely, Jebari et al. [ 4 ] studied 1,993 Dockerfiles from ML projects, characterizing their roles and build inefficiencies. These studies assess deployment artifacts against practices that apply independently of the application they deploy. Our operational contracts instead capture obligations that arise from the interaction between agent code and its deployment environment.
paragraphs.zh: 已有研究工作对容器部署制品进行了广泛研究。 相关研究刻画了 Docker 的使用情况 [ 16 ]，识别了 Docker 特有的重构与技术债务 [ 68 , 69 ]，并归纳了 Dockerfile [ 17 , 18 ]、Compose 文件 [ 19 , 70 ] 以及 Kubernetes 清单 [ 71 , 72 , 20 , 21 ] 中的实践与错误配置。 与本研究最接近的是，Jebari 等人。 [ 4 ] 研究了来自机器学习项目的 1,993 个 Dockerfile，刻画了它们的作用及构建低效问题。 这些研究依据的是独立于所部署应用而普遍适用的实践来评估部署制品。 我们的运行时契约则刻画了由智能体代码与其部署环境之间的交互所产生的义务。

paragraphs.en: Container platforms routinely restart, replace, and terminate containers, while agent systems carry saved state and running work across these deployment-platform events. Neither the agent framework nor the deployment platform states the deployment obligations needed when the two are combined. We introduced 14 operational contracts to make these obligations explicit and derived fourteen for LangGraph with Docker, Compose, and Kubernetes.
paragraphs.zh: 容器平台会例行地重启、替换和终止容器，而智能体系统需要在这些部署平台事件中携带已保存的状态和正在运行的工作。 无论是智能体框架还是部署平台，都没有说明两者结合时所需的部署义务。 我们引入了 14 项运维契约以使这些义务明确化，并为 LangGraph 结合 Docker、Compose 和 Kubernetes 推导出了十四条。

paragraphs.en: Across 433 deployed agent systems, the boundary is both widespread and failure-prone: at least one contract applies to 75.5% of systems, while 37.4% of those needing durable state lose it on restart and 41.5% on container replacement. Execution confirms that these violations matter: 14 of 16 predicted violations manifest as runtime failures, while all seven scorable predictions that a contract holds are confirmed. Developer repairs independently cover twelve contracts through 35 fix patterns; 78% modify application code, and only two thirds fully satisfy the deployment obligation.
paragraphs.zh: 在433个已部署的智能体系统中，这一边界既普遍存在又容易出错：至少有一个契约适用于75.5%的系统，而需要持久状态的系统中，37.4%在重启时丢失状态，41.5%在容器替换时丢失状态。 执行验证证实了这些违规确实很重要：16个预测的违规中有14个表现为运行时故障，而所有七个关于契约成立的可评分预测均得到证实。 开发者的修复通过35种修复模式独立覆盖了十二个契约；78%的修复修改了应用程序代码，且只有三分之二的修复完全满足部署义务。
